valueProps.title: Automated Market Maker (AMM)
valueProps.description: Deterministic pricing powered by constant-product formula (x * y = k) for 24/7 autonomous liquidity.

valueProps.title: Non-Custodial Architecture
valueProps.description: Traders retain 100% control over private keys and assets directly from their Web3 wallet.

valueProps.title: Cryptographic Block Settlement
valueProps.description: Instant transactions verified via SHA-256 binary Merkle proofs with zero intermediary delay.

faqs.question: How do I swap $LVAIR?
faqs.answer: Connect your Web3 wallet (MetaMask, Phantom, Binance, etc.), enter the swap amount in the DEX terminal, and confirm the transaction.

faqs.question: Are funds custodial?
faqs.answer: No. The protocol is 100% non-custodial. You retain direct ownership and control over your keys and funds at all times.

faqs.question: How do I claim the 250 $LVAIR Airdrop?
faqs.answer: Navigate to the Airdrop tab with a connected wallet and click 'Claim 250 $LVAIR Airdrop' to receive your allocation.
